## Install

Run `GogglesBridge-{{VERSION}}-Setup.exe`. Requires 64-bit Windows 10 or 11, an NVIDIA GPU, the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (included in Windows 11), and the DJI USB driver that [DJI Assistant 2 (Consumer Drones Series)](https://www.dji.com/downloads/softwares/dji-assistant-2-consumer-drones-series) installs. The installer isn't signed, so Windows might show a SmartScreen warning. To continue, select **More info**, and then select **Run anyway**.

SHA-256: `{{SHA256}}`

On a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 12.3 or later, open `GogglesBridge-{{VERSION}}.dmg`, and then drag Goggles Bridge to Applications.

SHA-256: `{{MAC_SHA256}}`
